osi.title: Order the 7 OSI layers (top = 7, bottom = 1)
osi.prompt: Drag or move the OSI layers into the correct order from Layer 7 (top) down to Layer 1 (bottom).

tcpip.title: Order the 4 TCP/IP layers (top to bottom)
tcpip.prompt: Arrange the 4 layers of the TCP/IP model from top (closest to the user app) to bottom (wire/radio).

encap.title: Order data encapsulation on the sender (top to bottom)
encap.prompt: Put the steps of encapsulation in order as data travels down the sender's stack.
items: 2. Transport adds TCP/UDP port header → Segment
3. Network adds source & destination IP → Packet
4. Data Link adds MAC header + FCS trailer → Frame
5. Physical transmits raw Bits onto the medium

devlayer.title: Match each network device to its primary OSI layer
devlayer.prompt: Match each device on the left with the OSI layer where it operates.
pairs: Layer 2 — Data Link (bridges Wi-Fi to LAN)

ports.title: Match protocols to their well-known port numbers
ports.prompt: Match each application protocol to its default TCP/UDP port.

pdu.title: Match each OSI layer to its PDU
pdu.prompt: Connect the OSI layer to the name of its Protocol Data Unit (PDU).
